notes.title: Beta Sign Up has begun
notes.content:
Everyone is now able to Sign Up for our Upcoming Betas.
Right now, you can sign up to get a chance to participate in at least one Upcoming Runner Beta.

[h2]FAQ[/h2]

[h3]What kind of Beta is this?[/h3]
We will have two Beta Phases!
One Closed Beta for Around 2500-5000 Users,
And one Open Beta for Every Other Users!

[h3]How long will the Playtest be?[/h3]
Every Beta Phase will last one Week!

[h3]Are the Zombies Available in Beta?[/h3]
Yes, We only don't want to show you the zombies right now, Because we think they are pretty unbalanced and unready right now.
Within the next 1-2 Devblogs we will show you more about the Zombies!

[h3]When is the Beta going to begin?[/h3]
Right now, we don't want to release a date. But we think that we are going to publish the beta before the end of the year 2021!

notes.title: What's Next?
notes.content:
[h2]What we want to change in the future[/h2]

First, we want to completely fix all known bugs and get that out the way before we continue adding more features.
At the current state we are on a good way and going with good empathy on this game.
One of our plans are to publish one Devblog every Month, And the first Dev blog would start on 08.05.21.

[h2]FAQ[/h2]

[h3]What are you planing to add to the game in the future?[/h3]
In the future, We want to add, for example:
[list]
[*]Dedicated Servers
[*]Drivable Cars
[*]Save Spaces were all players can come together
[*]Character Creation System
[*]Party System
[/list]More TBA Soon!

[h3]Who is Currently Developing the Game?[/h3]
The Game is currently developed by Basti200203.
But we are still looking for people who would like to help us get bigger.

[h3]Will there be a Beta?[/h3]
The Short answer: Yes
But right now we can't Really Say when. We want to publish a Closed and Open Beta.
Since steam published the Steam Playtest Feature, we want to use it that way.
You will be able to sign up For the Beta over Our Store Page.
Follow Our Updates to get informed when the First Beta starts!

[h3]Why haven't I had seen a Zombie so far?[/h3]
Because We are Currently working on a Zombie Behavior, how they are reacting to players or other objects around them. Since we are working on that, and we don't want to show get a negative feeling about them, We still want to wait for that and get on that later on a Devblog.

[h2]Just Send us some Questions or even just some Feedback For the future.
Thanks.[/h2]
